text: hello I'm so sorry to message I know you probably have much more serious things going on I'm a foster carer and the little boy with us is 6 he's had a temperature today it's 37.8 right now I gave him calpol a few hours ago and between the doses he's honestly been fine I think he's playing with his lego drinking his squash chatting away to me he's wide awake right now watching telly and asking for toast I checked him all over for a rash because I read you're supposed to and there's no rash anywhere on him I think I'm just being extra careful because he hasn't been with us very long and I don't know him that well yet and I don't want to get it wrong is there anything I should be watching for overnight or is it fine to just carry on with the calpol sorry again for taking up your time
